name: codebase-kb-engine
description: Generate a verifiable, graph-ready knowledge base inside any repository at ckb/, ready to commit: eight human docs (architecture with C4 views, workflows, business rules, system context, operations, security & data, decisions) plus a generated reference and a machine-readable ckb.json in the open CKB v0.2 format — purl-identified dependencies, what the repo publishes (artifacts, services), interfaces with call targets, datastores, config names, external services and API specs, every claim with verified path:line provenance and confidence, plus a coverage report. Polyglot (30+ manifest types, 20+ web frameworks). Skips when the committed KB is fresh. A fail-closed, session-scoped gate allows writes only to ckb/.
